title: Symmetry and reconstruction
description: Root algebras, graph complexes, and infinitesimal probes give independent entries into reconstruction. The shared guide connects their operations and examples.

title: From a formal identity to an obstruction
description: Follow one attempted logarithm in characteristic three. The quadratic correction succeeds; a cubic class records why the next lift fails. The exposition constructs its complex and spectral sequence as they are needed.

title: Two views of a polynomial composition law
description: Follow one criterion through two proofs: a direct module argument, then a Galois-theoretic and Frobenius-descent approach.

title: Turning arithmetic conditions into constructions
description: Two independent examples of making arithmetic tests explicit: algebraic traces and recurrences for a rounding problem, then factorial congruences for a prime selector.

title: Local control in analysis
description: Begin with a product oscillation estimate and Darboux sums, then read about compactness in Lebesgue's criterion. The weighting argument extends the theme to exceptional sets and convergence in measure.
